  A9 web part: pushed to its branch; qa has it.

⏺ qa raised one small thing that's yours to decide later. It doesn't block A9. I
  recorded it in the criteria file:

  File size limit: the server allows at most 5,000,000 bytes, and the page says
  "at most 5 MB". Some systems count sizes differently, so a file shown as "4.8
  MB" is already too big and gets refused.
  - Option A: change the page text to "4.7 MB". Text only. My pick.
  - Option B: raise the server limit to 5,242,880 bytes so the "5 MB" text matches.

  Still running: the backend gate and the deep review of the web code.
